about_the_game:
Welcome to BYTEWORLD, the ultimate VR experience where Twitch viewers and streamers come together!

  • Invite your viewers to join you directly on stream and bond with your community like never before!

  • Chat and interact with your viewers in realtime using the multiplayer network

  • Speak directly with viewers using the optional in-game voice chat

  • Play Twitch integrated minigames with viewers and chat at the same time

  • Invite other streamers to collaborate and join you as VR avatars

  • Discover new streamers to connect with using the built in browser

  • Only works with Twitch at the moment, but more platforms may be added in the future!

As a streamer (with the paid DLC), you will be able to host your own sessions as a giant VR avatar! With Twitch integration, minigames, various environments and plenty of items to cause chaos, you'll be able to interact with your community like never before!

As a free-to-play viewer, you will be able to discover new streamers or join your favourites live on stream as a little Byte! You'll be able to interact, message and even voice chat with the streamer and other community members! You can also play minigames, or even be brought into VR yourself as a guest!

To really show off your creative fashion sense, there are a wide range of cosmetics that can be worn by your Byte, ranging from funky hats to funky glasses and everything in-between! All you need to do is open your free daily crate and see what you get, or if you just can't wait, you can also purchase them from the shop.

No stream is complete without an amazing background environment, so feel free to check out the built-in level editor! You can design amazing worlds for your streamer to check out, and upload it directly to the Steam Workshop for anyone to download. The possibilities are endless!

name: BYTEWORLD

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440 3.1GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX650
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
